tagline: 美能达胶片单反相机，1985 年发布
description: 美能达于1985年推出的胶片单反相机。快门速度Focal plane shutter with speeds 30 sec. to 1/4000 sec.。使用DX-coded 35mm film with speeds from 6 to 6400 ASA。TTL phase detecting autofocus。

specs.胶片/画幅: DX-coded 35mm film with speeds from 6 to 6400 ASA
specs.快门: Focal plane shutter with speeds 30 sec. to 1/4000 sec.
specs.闪光灯: hot shoe for Minolta AF-flashes, TTL controlled operation, shutter synchronized for speed 1/60, 1/125 and 250 sec.
specs.英文简介: The Minolta 9000 was introduced in 1985 and was Minolta's first professional autofocus SLR.
